invitations.title: Open Invitations
invitations.empty: No open Invitations. An Invitation works once and expires 24 hours after it's issued.

inviteDialog.title: Invite someone to {{household}}
inviteDialog.description: Whoever opens the link becomes a member and sees all of this Household's Accounts, Transactions and history. Send it only to the person you mean.
inviteDialog.warning: It works once and expires {{expires}}. You won't see this code again after you close this dialog.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke this Invitation?
revokeDialog.description: Its link stops working at once.
revokeDialog.gone: That Invitation was no longer open

remove.title: Remove {{member}}?
remove.body: They lose access to {{household}} at once. They can come back only with a new Invitation.

leave.onlyMember: You're the only member. A Household always keeps at least one.
leave.title: Leave {{household}}?
leave.body: You lose access at once. You can come back only with a new Invitation from a member.
